basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old mechanical engineer based in Austin, Texas, navigating the early stages of my career while balancing a passion for virtual reality gaming and a newfound interest in Dynasty Baseball. I enjoy exploring the intersection of technology and entertainment, often spending weekends immersed in VR roleplaying games or catching up with friends over craft beers. Recently single, I am rediscovering the fun side of life and tend to be online late at night, especially during weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in mechanical engineering from Texas A&M University, my expertise lies in applying engineering principles to solve complex problems. I frequently apply this analytical mindset when diving into new hobbies or exploring technological advancements through self-teaching and community discussions.
